subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram channel can be wedged by bad persisted session JSON; status should detect and offer recovery

question: Should corrupted Telegram/session-store JSON recovery be diagnostic-only, an explicit backed-up status/doctor repair, or automatic load-time quarantine?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent behavior affects persisted session continuity and operator trust, so automation should not choose the destructive recovery policy on its own.

options.title: Diagnostic plus explicit repair
options.body: Status and doctor would report file path, size, parse/schema status, and offer a backed-up reset or doctor repair command that the operator explicitly runs.

options.title: Diagnostic only
options.body: Status and doctor would identify the bad artifact and recovery steps, but leave all mutation to manual operator action.

options.title: Automatic quarantine
options.body: Gateway load would move invalid state aside and recreate clean state automatically, accepting the risk of surprising session continuity loss.

recommendation.title: Diagnostic plus explicit repair
recommendation.body: Status and doctor would report file path, size, parse/schema status, and offer a backed-up reset or doctor repair command that the operator explicitly runs.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans state-storage policy, doctor UX, and plugin status boundaries where steipete has adjacent history.
